title: Canonical benchmark is the combined ON versus OFF cost bounded agentic bench
summary: Decision 2026-06-18 (corrects two points in the superseded note). Canonical Zonoid benchmark = the combined ON-vs-OFF cost-bounded agentic bench, built on scripts/bench-economy.js. CORRECTION 1 PROBLEMS: REUSE the existing featurebench problem set (bench/zonoid_bench, bench-questions.jsonl, the 73 probes with question + gold + seeded note) — do NOT author new scenarios. CORRECTION 2 ON CAP: ON gets a generous token CEILING (about 500k) only as a runaway safety cap, NOT a spend target; ON solving cheaply (e.g. 100k) is good. OFF arm cap = ON's ACTUAL measured spend on that problem (e.g. 100k), run till solved or cap hit. Do NOT inflate problem size to force ON toward 500k — that was the misunderstanding. ON runs production parity (full KB + DAG); grade correctness with the validated LLM-judge (featurebench metric) on each arm's final answer; per problem record ON solved + cost and whether OFF matched the outcome within ON's cost. The bench self-reveals contamination: cold-solvable categories (config, invariant) will show OFF matching ON cheaply = no memory win, while decision and gotcha show OFF failing within ON's budget = memory win. KEEP bench/economy + scripts/bench-economy.js as the execution foundation. DROP the old standalone evals (single-shot feature QA scoring, LOCOMO/LongMemEval agent-memory harness).
